title: 它们为什么一起走 · 素材

style: children's picture book illustration, soft pastel drawing with powdery blended strokes and visible grain, dusty blue, warm clay and pale sand

pages.scene: One single long-necked dinosaur standing on four thick legs, seen from the side facing left, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges. The object floats on this flat colour: it casts no shadow and rests on no ground, and there is no darker patch, wash, puddle, base, line or platform of any kind underneath it.
